# NorseLift — Full Documentation

> NorseLift is a free Progressive Web App (PWA) for tracking gym workouts, building custom training programs, and monitoring strength progress. Built for serious lifters who want simplicity over bloat.

## Product Description

NorseLift is a workout tracking application designed with a Norse-inspired aesthetic and a focus on simplicity. Unlike large fitness platforms that try to be everything — social network, meal planner, video library — NorseLift focuses on what matters in the gym: logging your work, tracking your progress, and getting stronger.

The app runs entirely in the browser as a Progressive Web App. Users can install it to their phone's home screen and use it like a native app, including offline. It installs straight from the browser and works on phones, tablets and desktop computers.

## Detailed Feature Breakdown

### Free Features

**Custom Workout Programs (up to 3)**
Users can create their own workout programs with custom exercise ordering. Common splits include Push/Pull/Legs, Upper/Lower, Full Body, or any custom arrangement. Each program defines which exercises to perform and in what order.

**Workout Logging**
During a workout, users log sets with reps and weight. The interface is optimized for quick entry between sets. Previous performance is shown for reference so users know what to beat.

**Rest Timer**
A built-in rest timer counts down between sets. On supported Android devices it vibrates when the rest period ends (iOS browsers do not support web vibration). The timer duration is customizable.

**Exercise Library**
A searchable library of exercises organized by muscle group. Users can browse or search to find exercises and add them to their programs.

**Cloud Sync**
All data syncs to the cloud via Firebase, so workouts are accessible from any device. Start a workout on your phone at the gym, review your stats on your laptop at home.

**Full Workout History**
Free users can view their complete workout history. Sessions from the last 7 days can be edited or deleted; older sessions are read-only on Free.

**1 Scheduled Routine**
Free users can schedule one recurring workout routine.

### Pro Features ($4.99/month, $10.49/quarter, or $29.99/year)

**Unlimited Programs**
No limit on the number of workout programs. Create programs for different training phases, goals, or seasons.

**Edit Any Session & Backfill**
Edit or delete any past session, and backfill workouts you forgot to log.

**Unlimited Scheduled Routines**
Schedule as many recurring workout routines as needed.

**Progress Insights**
Exercise progression charts (estimated 1RM, top set, volume) with next-session targets, weekly volume per muscle group, strength details, monthly recap and cardio trend.

**Records Collection**
A Records view collecting every personal record. (PR detection and the post-workout PR celebration are free.)

**Training Block History**
Creating training blocks (bulk, cut, maintain) is free; Pro adds block history and comparisons.

**Duplicate Routines**
Copy an existing routine as a starting point for a new one.

### Newcomer Offer
New subscribers only: the first month of a monthly Pro subscription is $1.99 (the "Newcomer offer"), then $4.99/month. The Newcomer offer applies to the monthly plan only.

## Use Cases

1. **Structured Lifters**: People following a specific program (like 5/3/1, PPL, PHUL) who need to track sets/reps/weight systematically.
2. **Gym Beginners**: New lifters who want a simple tool to build their first program and track consistency.
3. **Multi-Device Users**: People who want to log at the gym on their phone and review stats on their computer.
4. **Privacy-Conscious Users**: People who prefer a simple tool over apps that require social profiles or collect excessive data.
5. **Budget-Conscious Lifters**: People who want a capable free tier or affordable Pro pricing.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Do I need to download anything?**
A: No. NorseLift is a Progressive Web App that runs in your browser. You can optionally "Add to Home Screen" for a native app experience.

**Q: Does it work offline?**
A: Yes. The app caches your data locally and syncs when you're back online.

**Q: What devices does it support?**
A: Any device with a modern web browser — iPhone, Android, iPad, laptop, desktop.

**Q: How much is Pro?**
A: Pro is $4.99/month, $10.49 every 3 months, or $29.99/year (USD). New subscribers get their first month for $1.99 with the Newcomer offer, then $4.99/mo. Cancel anytime.

**Q: Can I cancel my Pro subscription anytime?**
A: Yes. You can cancel anytime through the subscription management page. Your Pro features remain active until the end of your billing period.

**Q: Is my data safe?**
A: Yes. Data is stored securely with Firebase (Google Cloud) and synced across your devices with end-to-end authentication.

**Q: Can I export my data?**
A: Data portability features are on the roadmap.
